statement: These are transparent model-informed starting values, not claimed expert consensus or empirical validation.
assumptions: Normalized criterion performance lies between zero and one.
Development weights express defensible initial importance and remain replaceable.
ELECTRE thresholds represent materially different performance on the normalized scale.
Formal approval requires structured expert elicitation and sensitivity review.

artifacts.purpose: Criterion normalization and provisional criterion weights
Credibility, discrimination, indifference, preference and veto thresholds
Explicit allocation from broad DEMATEL drivers to operational criteria
